description.zh: 修改后的管理员列表。多个用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多不超过3个。
description.en: The updated list of administrators. Separate multiple administrators with commas (,). You can specify up to three administrators.

description.zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center specified in the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) call. Valid values: cn-shanghai (Shanghai) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).

description.zh: 修改后的群组扩展信息，长度不超过32KB。
description.en: The updated extended information of the group. The information can be up to 32 KB in length.
Specifies whether to modify the group administrators.

description.zh: 是否修改群组扩展信息。
description.en: Specifies whether to modify the extended information of the group.

title.zh: 修改直播互动群组信息

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~)创建互动消息群组。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, call [CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~) to create an interactive message group.

## QPS limit

This operation has a queries per second (QPS) limit of 50 for each user. If you exceed the limit, API calls are throttled. This may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live modify-live-message-group --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --modify-admin true --admin-list uid1 --modify-info true --group-info newmeta --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live ModifyLiveMessageGroup --region cn-hangzhou --AdminList uid1 --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --ModifyAdmin true --GroupInfo newmeta --ModifyInfo true --GroupId grouptest
